OAT-06/S07.title: Send a handoff in both contexts: generated and sent rows, follow-up answer, Skip, colleague, Copy
OAT-06/S07.detail: Local Playwright spec newspec-c/an2-oat06-s07-handoff.spec.ts: a brand-new sender plus a second brand-new @roundai.test colleague ('Dr. QA Colleague <tag>', its own signed-in context). On main e02167f the handoff screen generates each patient's summary with ai.assist.generateHandoff (client side) and sends in-app with handoffs.send; TFA-92586's PR #104 (four sections, server-side summary) is not on main and nothing here needs it. generateHandoff is answered at the Convex socket. Judged 13/13: Hospital: handoff_generated (hospital, patientCount 1) written before handoff_sent; exactly one handoff_sent (hospital) carrying the sent handoff's id and patientCount 1 (the sheet size); the 'Handoff follow-up question' dialog ('Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' with Yes / No / Not sure) appears 108 ms after Send; 'Not sure' stores one surveyResponses handoff_followup row {moreLikelyToSendHandoff: not_sure} with that handoffId and the dialog closes. Nursing Home: handoff_generated and exactly one handoff_sent (nursing_home, patientCount 1, handoffId); the prompt appears (209 ms); Skip stores no survey row. Today's rollup for the sender: handoffsGenerated +1 and handoffsSent +1 in each care setting. Colleague: the received handoff opens with the patient on the sheet and no follow-up prompt; the colleague has no handoff_* usage row, no handoff_followup row and no rollup row. U15: no usage or survey row holds a patient name, room or the handoff text. Recorded only (Q20): Copy Text shows 'Copied', writes no usage or survey row and brings up no prompt. Todo (TFA-94609, ready for pr, T4): 'fires every time' and Skip as a dismissal are not judged. Part left: U13 for generateHandoff (aiCallLog providerMs / model, audit provider_ms) needs a live call; locally it is answered in the browser, and dev has no generateHandoff reading yet (review plan: a dev agent unit opens the handoff screen without sending, once Quinn accepts one AI call per patient on the shared account).
